expo.name: Pro Audio
expo.description: Pro Audio Training Academy — a 26,000-term professional audio glossary, real phone-based measurement tools (SPL, RTA, spectrogram, RT60, tuner), interactive audio labs, and certificate programs for audio engineers.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used to measure sound levels in the measurement tools, and — only when you tap the mic — to dictate a glossary search. Audio is processed on this device and is not recorded or uploaded.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used by the Light-Pulse frequency counter to measure how fast a light flashes (overall image brightness only), and to add an optional photo to a measurement snapshot. No photo or video is uploaded.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Used only when you choose to tag a measurement snapshot with where it was taken. Location is stored with the snapshot on this device and never shared automatically.

plugins.microphonePermission: Used to measure sound levels in the measurement tools, and — only when you tap the mic — to dictate a glossary search. Audio is processed on this device and is not recorded or uploaded.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Used only when you tap the mic to dictate a glossary search, to turn your speech into search text.

plugins.savePhotosPermission: Used only when you tap SAVE on a lab drawing or a measurement snapshot, to add that image to your Photos. Nothing is read from your library.
plugins.photosPermission: Used only when you tap SAVE on a lab drawing or a measurement snapshot, to add that image to your Photos. Nothing is uploaded.
